plaatsen.tekst: A man shall be satisfied with good by the fruit of his mouth: and the recompence of a man's hands shall be rendered
Say to them that are of a fearful heart, Be strong, fear not: behold, your God will come with vengeance, even God with a recompence; he will come and save
According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, fury to his adversaries, recompence to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompence.
A voice of noise from the city, a voice from the temple, a voice of the LORD that rendereth recompence to his enemies.
Render unto them a recompence, O LORD, according to the work of their hands.

Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;

Yea, and what have ye to do with me, O Tyre, and Zidon, and all the coasts of Palestine? will ye render me a recompence? and if ye recompense me, swiftly and speedily will I return your recompence upon your own head;
Behold, I will raise them out of the place whither ye have sold them, and will return your recompence upon your own head:
Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.
Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him: for the reward of his hands shall be given
For the day of the LORD is near upon all the heathen: as thou hast done, it shall be done unto thee: thy reward shall return upon thine own head.
But Hezekiah rendered not again according to the benefit done unto him; for his heart was lifted up: therefore there was wrath upon him, and upon Judah and Jerusalem.

Now therefore, if ye have done truly and sincerely, in that ye have made Abimelech king, and if ye have dealt well with Jerubbaal and his house, and have done unto him according to the deserving of his hands;
He that hath pity upon the poor lendeth unto the LORD; and that which he hath given will he pay him again.
